# ⚖️ Code of Conduct & Governance Protocol

## 1. The DX Standard and Human Excellence

`**HYPER-FLOW** led by glastor-core` is not just code; it is a high-performance engineering ecosystem.
Our mission is to build robust solutions while maintaining an exceptional Developer Experience (DX).
This protocol ensures collaboration is predictable, respectful, and focused on technical excellence.

---

## 2. Pillars of Sustainable Software Engineering

### 🤝 High-Impact Collaboration

- **Technical Empathy & Peer Review:** We approach code reviews and architectural debates with
  technical rigor and professional courtesy. Code quality supersedes personal ego.
- **Transparent Accountability:** We acknowledge mistakes immediately, transforming them into
  automated tests, optimizations, and documentation.
- **Data-Driven Feedback:** Architectural proposals must be backed by benchmarks, open standards,
  and proven patterns.

### 🚫 Zero Tolerance

- **Harassment & Discrimination:** Any derogatory language, discriminatory behavior, or toxic
  conduct will result in immediate suspension.
- **Trolling & Derailing:** Spam and disruptive interference in issues or pull requests degrade
  productivity and will be moderated.
- **Doxxing:** Sharing private personal details or credentials results in permanent expulsion.

---

## 3. Artificial Intelligence & Code Integrity (GitHub 2026)

- **Transparency in AI Contributions:** Substantial contributions generated or assisted by Large
  Language Models (LLMs) or autonomous coding agents must be explicitly declared in the Pull Request
  description.
- **IP & License Compliance:** Contributors are strictly responsible for verifying that AI-assisted
  code does not reproduce copyrighted code or violate third-party open-source licenses.

---

## 4. Incident Response Protocol

To report an ethics or conduct violation:

- 📩 **Integrity Channel:** [glastor.info@gmail.com](mailto:glastor.info@gmail.com)
- **Response SLA:** The maintainers will acknowledge and process reports within **48 to 72 business
  hours** under strict confidentiality.
